findings.text: follow-on: s4 states 'reckon crew dispatch increments the target section's attempts' but the landed change derives the count from run history and never writes it (reckon/mcp_views.py:1474), so the plan text and the code disagree about the mechanism.

follow-on: the manifest's changed_paths names reckon/crew/promotion.py, but no node commit changes it; the net 81b5353..cea34116 change there belongs to the peer commit 6db8d13e1, so a reader reconciling changed_paths against the node's commits finds an entry the node did not author.

follow-on: delivering section_attempts on the roadmap ready set adds a per-call aggregation; the run's paired logs measure the roadmap build rising 29.894s to 38.046s and the section view 6.182s to 9.316s on a 3604-row ledger, a cost paid on every read for a count that moves only when a run launches or completes.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; the launch-counting write (faca5b63) was reverted by d2b52e548, leaving a derived read (reckon/mcp_views.py:1474), a write-time strip of the legacy attempts attribute (reckon/_store.py:1382), server delivery (reckon/serve.py:3042), and section routing by the derived count (reckon/crew/routing.py:326).
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's four outcomes are asserted by tests/test_section_attempts_are_tool_owned.py:161-262 (two dispatches and one promotion leave attempts at 2, a resume leaves it unchanged, outcomes are recorded, the stored plan carries no counter), and the manifest records the head gate at 238 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is the s4 tool-owned attempt counter; the landed change derives it from distinct implement/test run ids (reckon/mcp_views.py:1474 section_attempts_by_plan) and delivers it on the section heading (docs/ui/plan.jsx:771) and the roadmap ready set (reckon/roadmap.py:2874) instead of writing a stored count at dispatch.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at orientation; status complete, commits ending cea34116, baseline_suite revision 5ebe5d8f (13 failed) and after_suite revision cea34116 (238 passed, 0 failed), negative control whose last line reads EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node's commits change its declared production files (reckon/mcp_views.py, reckon/_store.py, reckon/serve.py, reckon/roadmap.py, docs/ui/plan.jsx, reckon/crew/routing.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py) plus its tests; reckon/crew/promotion.py is named in changed_paths but no node commit touches it.

justifications.durability: tests/test_section_attempts_are_tool_owned.py:161 dispatches real runs and reads the count back through the real view path, so a return to a stored counter reddens it, and the declared negative control reddens the analogue at EXIT=1.
justifications.evidence: the run's baseline-suite-merged-guard.log records 13 failed EXIT=1 at 5ebe5d8f against after-suite-merged-guard-retry.log at 238 passed EXIT=0 at cea34116, and the done_when's four outcomes are asserted by tests/test_section_attempts_are_tool_owned.py:161-262.
justifications.fit: the added symbols (section_attempts_by_plan, section_attempt_count, _group_section_attempts) name the mechanism, the twenty node commits carry conventional subjects with bodies and no AI trailer, and no plan or sprint identifier reaches source.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp_views.py:1474 derives the count and outcomes from distinct implement/test run ids and reckon/roadmap.py:2874 exposes them, but the s4 text still describes a written counter, so the mechanism diverges from the plan's letter.
justifications.scope_discipline: every node commit lands inside the declared production paths, though reckon/crew/promotion.py appears in the manifest's changed_paths with no change the node authored (reckon/crew/promotion.py:1).
